specs.Antenna Location: For the beach, pool party or rain

features: Loud, powerful sound: And it rocks further with the JBL Flip Essential 3 SE 2-way speaker system for loud, crystal clear sound. Racetrack woofer, separate tweeter and passive radiators provide rich bass.

IP67 waterproof and dustproof: suitable for swimming pool. For the park. The JBL Flip Essential 3 SE is IP67 waterproof and dustproof, so you can take it anywhere without worrying about water or dust.
Up to 12 hours playback time: don't worry about charging. The JBL Flip Essential 3 SE offers up to 12 hours of playback time on just one battery charge for long-lasting music enjoyment.

Auracast multi-speaker connectivity: Auracast lets you pair two Flip Essential 3 SE for a larger sonic area, or connect multiple Auracast-enabled JBL speakers to fill more room with the same playlist.
JBL Portable App: Maximize your audio experience with the JBL Portable App. Get updates and product support, unlock features, amplify your audio or optimize bass for full control over your sound.
Box contents: 1 x JBL Flip Essential 3 SE / 1 x Quick Start Guide / 1 x Warranty Card & Safety Data Sheet
Output Power : 20 W RMS for woofer, 10 W RMS for tweeter
